author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Not everyone does this right, the KERDI-DRAIN has to be supported in thin-set mortar. Specifically the four corners and the tray recess need mortar. I ensure the grate frame is square, level, and slightly below the 4 inch porcelain tiles. If you’re tiling a shower floor and need help, check out my online courses at  https://homerepairtutor.com
title: Tile Shower Floor Tips with 4 inch Porcelain - #tileshower #bathroomremodel #homerenovation #howto
